scheme_name: Scheme of Grant-in-Aid to Voluntary Organisations Working for the Welfare of Scheduled Tribes
other_conditions: The applicant must be a registered voluntary organisation/NGO under the Societies Registration Act, 1860, a State Society Registration, Public Trust or any other applicable act
The organisation must be registered on the NGO‑Darpan portal of NITI Aayog
It must have at least three years of experience in activities similar in size and objectives to the proposed project
The organisation must implement the project itself and may not transfer the grant to another entity
It must agree to the terms and conditions and sign a Memorandum of Understanding with the Ministry
It must open an Aadhaar‑linked bank account in its name with an authorized scheduled bank
The organisation must possess PAN and TAN numbers and have filed Income Tax Returns for at least the last three years
It must be registered under section 12A of the Income Tax Act
The organisation must not be bankrupt or under investigation for economic offences by CBI, ED, CBIC or any other Union/State agency
It must have sufficient financial capacity to co‑finance the project’s core activities
Details of trustees, promoters, beneficial owners and their PAN and Aadhaar numbers must be submitted
The organisation must not be black‑listed by NITI Aayog, Union or State ministries
A minimum of 75 beneficiaries is required to start the project, except in exceptional cases where at least 25 ST students may be considered
benefits_summary: Grants are provided to NGOs for projects that improve education, health, livelihood and other welfare services for Scheduled Tribes, including emergency assistance during disasters.
documents_required: Proof of registration under the Societies Registration Act, State Society Registration or Public Trust
Income Tax Returns for the last three years
Details of trustees/promoters/beneficial owners with PAN and Aadhaar
Signed Memorandum of Understanding with the Ministry
